text: Code reviews are an important part of software development. When developers review each other's code before it is merged, they can catch bugs early, when fixes are simple and cheap. This saves time and money later. Code reviews also support knowledge sharing: team members learn from each other, discover new techniques, and understand different parts of the project. In addition, regular reviews improve team quality, because everyone follows the same standards and gives helpful feedback. Although reviews take extra time, they are worth it. A strong review culture builds better software and a more skilled, confident team.
